template_notes: Fill every value_m from the sections, elevations or schedules and name the source in authority.
Leave a block out rather than guessing: a missing height keeps its quantities BLOCKED; nothing here is a default.
The engine refuses this file until every value_m present is a number with an authority (FactsError).
wall_heights: the finish height per trade; '*' applies to every floor, a floor key (GF, 1F, ...) overrides it.
WALL_TILE: the wall-tile height of wet rooms (UP-CER-004 compares it with the clear height for skirting).

opening_heights: door / window heights (DOOR, WINDOW; DOOR.MAIN_ENTRANCE, DOOR.INTERNAL.PVC, DOOR.EXTERNAL.ALUMINIUM for a class height). DOOR_ASSUMED is an owner-authorised fallback: it stays ASSUMED and never enters confirmed door areas.
Prepared for the blind round's assisted mode by a person who has not seen the benchmark; hash the filled file before the run (protocol URBAN_BLIND_V1, section 5).
